Reward-shaped functions and their access control read from source: PadFarm.harvest() public but modifier hasRewards = require(myRewards()>0) (needs an existing stake, not a role); PadFarmsV2.payVault() public, transfers tokensToPay() to vaultAddress (pays the vault, not the caller); mintPad() public, calls Minter.mint() which does bep20.mint(msg.sender) so PAD is credited to the farm, not to the caller (Minter.mint() itself is onlyPositiveBal, i.e. caller must hold minter shares); ToadFarm.roll()/withdraw() public with modifier onlyDivis = require(myDividends()>0).
